title: Epidemiologic Study to Evaluate the Proportion of Cardiovascular Disease Risk Factors in Korean Hypertensive Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is investigating the proportion of Cardiovascular disease risk factors of hypertensive patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Essential hypertensive patient no less than 18 yeas old
* Patient who gave informed consent form

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient was diagnosed as secondary hypertension
* Patient who have white-coat hypertension
